strings.b-00-meta.title: Electric Current ke Magnetic Effects
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.0: Is lesson ke baad aap magnet ke magnetic field ko describe kar sakte hain aur magnetic field lines ke properties list kar sakte hain.
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.1: Is lesson ke baad aap right-hand thumb rule use karke straight wire, circular loop aur solenoid mein current se produce hone wale magnetic field ki direction find kar sakte hain.
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.2: Is lesson ke baad aap Fleming's left-hand rule use karke magnetic field mein rakhe current-carrying conductor par lagne wale force ki direction find kar sakte hain.
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.3: Is lesson ke baad aap domestic circuit ke live, neutral aur earth wires explain kar sakte hain, aur kyun electric fuse circuit ko short-circuiting aur overloading se protect karta hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.0.definition: Magnet ke around ka woh region jahan magnet ka force detect kiya ja sakta hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.1.definition: Woh line jiske along iron filings magnet ke around line up hote hain; us par rakhi compass needle uski direction ke along point karti hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.2.definition: Straight current-carrying wire ke around field ki direction ke liye rule: thumb current ke along, curled fingers field ke along.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.3.definition: Current-carrying conductor par force ki direction ke liye rule: forefinger field ke along, second finger current ke along, thumb force ke along.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.4.definition: Cylinder ke shape mein wound many circular turns ki coil, jiska field bar magnet jaisa hota hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.5.definition: Soft iron core jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai, aur coil se current pass karke use magnetic banaya jaata hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.6.definition: Ek safety device jo bahut zyada current flow hone par melt ho jaata hai aur circuit break kar deta hai, appliances ko damage se bachata hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.7.definition: Ek fault jisme live wire aur neutral wire directly touch ho jaate hain, isliye circuit ka current abruptly badh jaata hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.8.definition: Green-insulated safety wire jo earth mein metal plate se connected hoti hai, jo metallic appliance body ko earth ke potential par rakhti hai.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.0: Aap electric current ka ek effect already jaante hain: yeh jis wire se flow karta hai use heat karta hai. Ek doosra effect bhi hai. Current carry karne wali wire bhi magnet ki tarah behave karti hai, aur aap ise compass se dekh sakte hain.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.1: Ek thick straight copper wire lein aur use electric circuit ke do points X aur Y ke beech connect karein. Wire ko paper ke plane ke perpendicular rakhein. Wire ke paas ek chhota compass horizontally rakhein aur uski needle ki position note karein.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.2: Ab key insert karein taaki current flow ho, aur needle ko phir dekhein. Needle deflected hai. Copper wire ke through electric current ne magnetic effect produce kiya hai. Electricity aur magnetism ek doosre se linked hain.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.3: Yeh link accidentally mila tha. 1820 mein, Hans Christian Oersted ne discover kiya ki jab ek metallic wire ke paas se electric current pass hota hai to compass needle deflect ho jaati hai. Unki observation ne dikhaya ki electricity aur magnetism related phenomena the.
strings.b-02.question: Jab compass needle ko bar magnet ke paas laaya jaata hai, to woh deflect kyun ho jaati hai?
strings.b-02.options.0: Magnet ka field needle par force (bal) exert karta hai, kyunki needle khud ek chhota magnet hai.
strings.b-02.options.1: Magnet sirf compass ke glass cover ko attract karta hai, needle ko nahi.
strings.b-02.options.2: Needle copper se bani hai, jise koi bhi magnet attract karta hai.
strings.b-02.options.3: Magnet needle ko heat karta hai, aur heat se needle ghoom jaati hai.
strings.b-02.explanation: Compass needle ek chhota bar magnet hota hai. Bar magnet apne aas-paas magnetic field banata hai, aur us field ke andar doosre magnet par force act karta hai, isliye needle turn (ghoom) jaati hai.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.0: Compass needle ek chhota bar magnet hota hai. Iske do sire lagbhag north aur south directions ki taraf point karte hain. Jo end north ki taraf point karta hai use north-seeking ya north pole kehte hain; doosra end, jo south ki taraf point karta hai, use south-seeking ya south pole kehte hain. Like poles ek doosre ko repel karte hain, aur unlike poles ek doosre ko attract karte hain.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.1: Drawing board par white paper ki ek sheet fix karo. Centre mein ek bar magnet rakho aur uske chaaron taraf iron filings uniformly sprinkle karo. Board ko halke se tap karo. Iron filings ek pattern mein arrange ho jaati hain.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.2: Ye pattern mein kyun arrange hoti hain? Magnet apne aas-paas ke region mein influence daalta hai, aur filings force (bal) experience karti hain. Magnet ke aas-paas ka woh region jismein magnet ki force detect ki ja sakti hai, usme magnetic field hota hai. Jin lines ke along iron filings align hoti hain, woh magnetic field lines represent karti hain.
strings.b-04.caption: Bar magnet ke aas-paas field lines. Arrowheads convention dikhate hain: lines north pole se bahar aati hain, magnet ke bahar curve ho kar south pole mein andar jati hain, isliye har line ek closed curve hai. Poles ke paas lines crowded hoti hain, jahan field sabse strong hai.
strings.b-05.paragraphs.0: Ab chaar properties follow hoti hain. Pehli, kisi point par magnetic field ki direction wahi hoti hai jis direction mein compass needle ka north pole wahan move karta. Convention ke hisaab se, field lines north pole se bahar nikalti hain aur south pole par milti hain, aur magnet ke andar unki direction south pole se north pole ki taraf hoti hai, isliye field lines closed curves hoti hain.
strings.b-05.paragraphs.1: Doosri, field ki relative strength lines ke closeness ki degree se dikhti hai: jahan lines crowded hoti hain wahan field stronger hota hai. Teesri, koi bhi do field lines ek doosre ko cross nahi karti, kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions ki taraf point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
strings.b-05.paragraphs.2: Chauthi, needle ka deflection badhta hai jab use field line ke along poles ki taraf move kiya jata hai.
strings.b-06.title: Compass se ek magnetic field line kaise draw karein
strings.b-06.steps.0.title: Setup karein
strings.b-06.steps.0.detail: Drawing board par white paper ki ek sheet fix karein, us par bar magnet rakhein aur magnet ki boundary mark karein.
strings.b-06.steps.1.title: Pehli position
strings.b-06.steps.1.detail: Compass ko magnet ke north pole ke paas rakhein. Needle ka south pole magnet ke north pole ki taraf point karta hai, aur compass ka north pole magnet ke north pole se door ki direction mein hota hai. Needle ke dono ends ki positions mark karein.
strings.b-06.steps.2.title: Aage badhein
strings.b-06.steps.2.detail: Needle ko nayi position par move karein aise ki uska south pole wahi position le le jo pehle uske north pole ne li thi.
strings.b-06.steps.3.title: South pole tak continue karein
strings.b-06.steps.3.detail: Isi tarah step by step aage badhein jab tak magnet ke south pole tak na pahunch jayein.
strings.b-06.steps.4.title: Marks ko join karein
strings.b-06.steps.4.detail: Paper par mark kiye gaye points ko ek smooth curve se join karein. Yeh curve ek field line represent karti hai.
strings.b-06.steps.5.title: Repeat karein
strings.b-06.steps.5.detail: Poora procedure repeat karein aur jitni lines draw kar sakte hain utni lines draw karein. Saath milkar yeh magnet ke around magnetic field represent karti hain.
strings.b-07.question: Do magnetic field lines ek dusre ko intersect kyun nahi karti?
strings.b-07.options.0: Kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions ki taraf point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
strings.b-07.options.1: Kyunki field lines hamesha straight hoti hain aur straight lines kabhi meet nahi karti.
strings.b-07.options.2: Kyunki har crossing point par magnetic field zero hota hai.
strings.b-07.options.3: Kyunki field lines sirf magnet ke andar exist karti hain.
strings.b-07.explanation: Kisi point par field ki direction wahi hoti hai jis direction mein compass needle ka north pole wahan move karega. Ek single point do directions nahi de sakta, isliye do field lines cross nahi kar sakti.
strings.b-08.question: Is chapter mein magnetic field produce karne ke kaun se do methods dikhaye gaye hain?
strings.b-08.options.0: Magnet ka use karke, aur conductor se electric current pass karke.
strings.b-08.options.1: Wire ko garam karke, aur magnet ko thanda karke.
strings.b-08.options.2: Copper wire ko ragad karke, aur magnet ko tukdon mein todkar.
strings.b-08.options.3: Wire par light daal kar, aur tez awaaz karke.
strings.b-08.explanation: Magnetic field magnet ke aas-paas ke region mein hota hai, aur electric current carry karne wale metallic wire ke saath bhi ek magnetic field associated hota hai.
strings.b-09.paragraphs.0: Current ke through conductor mein generate hone wale magnetic field ka pattern kya decide karta hai? Pattern conductor ki shape par depend karta hai. Long straight wire se start karte hain.
strings.b-09.paragraphs.1: Ek long straight copper wire, 1.5 V ke do ya teen cells aur ek plug key lein, aur unhe series mein connect karein. Straight wire ko compass needle ke parallel aur uske upar rakhein, phir key plug karein. Agar current north se south ki taraf flow karta hai, to compass needle ka north pole east ki taraf move karta hai. Ab cell connections ko replace karein taki current south se north ki taraf flow kare; needle west ki taraf move karta hai. Current reverse hone par magnetic field ki direction reverse ho jati hai.
strings.b-10.caption: Seedhi current-carrying wire ka field, jab wire ke along dekha jaye: field lines wire par centred concentric circles hain, aur jaise-jaise hum door jaate hain yeh aur bade hote jaate hain. Arrowheads field ki direction dikhate hain jab current page se bahar aa raha ho.
strings.b-10.svg_texts.t-0: wire end-on dikhi hai; current page se bahar aa raha hai
strings.b-11.paragraphs.0: Same experiment se do aur facts milte hain. Agar aap wire mein current badhate hain, to needle ka deflection badh jata hai; iska matlab hai ki kisi diye gaye point par magnetic field ka magnitude badh jata hai jab wire mein current badhta hai.
strings.b-11.paragraphs.1: Agar aap current same rakhte hain lekin compass ko wire se door le jaate hain, to deflection kam ho jata hai; iska matlab hai ki diye gaye current se produce hone wala field kam ho jata hai jab wire se distance (doori) badhta hai. Field ko represent karne wale concentric circles aur bade hote jaate hain jab hum wire se door jaate hain.
strings.b-12.question: Nimnlikhit mein se kaun sa sahi tarah se ek lambi seedhi current-carrying wire ke paas magnetic field (chumbakiya kshetra) ka varnan karta hai?
strings.b-12.options.0: Field seedhi lines se bana hai jo wire ke perpendicular hain.
strings.b-12.options.1: Field seedhi lines se bana hai jo wire ke parallel hain.
strings.b-12.options.2: Field radial lines se bana hai jo wire se nikalti hain.
strings.b-12.options.3: Field concentric circles se bana hai jo wire par kendrit hain.
strings.b-12.explanation: Ek seedhi current-carrying wire ke aas-paas chhidke hue iron filings wire ke chaaron taraf concentric circles mein vyavasthit ho jate hain, aur yeh circles field lines ko darshate hain.
strings.b-13.paragraphs.0: Yahan ek aasan tarika hai yaad rakhne ka ki ek seedhi current-carrying conductor ke around field ki direction kya hoti hai. Socho ki aap conductor ko apne right hand mein is tarah pakde hue hain ki aapka thumb current ki direction ki taraf point karta hai. Phir aapki fingers conductor ke around field lines ki direction mein lapet jaati hain. Yahi right-hand thumb rule hai.
strings.b-13.paragraphs.1: Isi rule ko Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kaha jata hai: agar aap maan lein ki aap current ki direction mein ek corkscrew drive kar rahe hain, to corkscrew ke rotation ki direction hi magnetic field (chumbakiya kshetra) ki direction hoti hai.
strings.b-14.problem: Ek horizontal power line mein current east se west direction mein flow karta hai. Iske exactly neeche ek point aur exactly upar ek point par magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
strings.b-14.steps.0.title: Thumb ko point karo
strings.b-14.steps.0.detail: Power line ko apne right hand mein is tarah pakdo ki aapka thumb current ke along point kare, yani east se west.
strings.b-14.steps.1.title: Fingers ko curl karo
strings.b-14.steps.1.detail: Aapki fingers wire ke around wrap ho jati hain. Ye wire ke perpendicular plane mein field lines ki direction batati hain.
strings.b-14.steps.2.title: Ek end se dekho
strings.b-14.steps.2.detail: East end se dekhein to ye curling clockwise hai; west end se dekhein to anti-clockwise.
strings.b-14.steps.3.title: Upar aur neeche same
strings.b-14.steps.3.detail: Wire ke exactly neeche ya exactly upar kisi point par kuch nahi badalta: east end se dekhein to field abhi bhi wire ke perpendicular plane mein clockwise turn karta hai, aur west end se dekhein to anti-clockwise.
strings.b-14.answer: Wire ke exactly neeche ya exactly upar kisi bhi point par, east end se dekhein to magnetic field wire ke perpendicular plane mein clockwise turn karta hai, aur west end se dekhein to anti-clockwise.
strings.b-15.question: Kaun sa rule straight current-carrying conductor ke around produce hone wale magnetic field ki direction batata hai?
strings.b-15.options.0: Right-hand thumb rule, jise Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kaha jata hai.
strings.b-15.options.1: Woh rule jis ke anusar compass needle north ki taraf point karti hai.
strings.b-15.options.2: Woh rule jis ke anusar like poles repel karte hain aur unlike poles attract karte hain.
strings.b-15.options.3: Woh rule jis ke anusar iron filings straight lines mein settle hoti hain.
strings.b-15.explanation: Current-carrying straight conductor ko apne right hand mein is tarah pakdo ki thumb current ki direction mein point kare. Phir aapki fingers conductor ke around magnetic field lines ki direction mein wrap hoti hain.
strings.b-16.paragraphs.0: Ab us straight wire ko circular loop mein bend karo aur usme current pass karo. Ek straight wire ka magnetic field usse distance (doori) par inversely depend karta hai; isi tarah, current-carrying circular loop ke har point par field ko represent karne wale concentric circles wire se door jane par aur bade hote jaate hain.
strings.b-16.paragraphs.1: Jab hum loop ke centre tak pahunchte hain, in bade circles ke arcs straight lines jaise dikhte hain. Current-carrying wire ka har point aisa magnetic field banata hai jo loop ke centre par straight line jaise dikhta hai. Right-hand rule apply karne se pata chalta hai ki wire ka har section loop ke andar magnetic field lines ko same direction mein contribute karta hai.
strings.b-16.paragraphs.2: Kisi given point par current-carrying wire se produce hone wala magnetic field usme pass hone wale current par directly depend karta hai. Isliye agar ek circular coil mein n turns hain, to produce hone wala field single turn se produce hone wale field ka n times hota hai: har circular turn mein current ki direction same hoti hai, aur turns ke due to fields simply add up ho jaate hain.
strings.b-17.caption: Ek circular loop jisme current clockwise direction mein flow ho raha hai. Centre par crossed circle field B ko mark karta hai, jo loop ke plane ke perpendicular hai aur page ke andar ki taraf point karta hai; centre par field lines straight lines ki tarah dikhti hain.
strings.b-18.paragraphs.0: Solenoid ek coil hoti hai jisme cylinder ke shape mein wound kai circular turns hote hain. Current-carrying solenoid ke through aur uske around magnetic field lines ka pattern bar magnet jaisa hota hai, aur solenoid ka ek end magnetic north pole ki tarah act karta hai. Current carry karte hue ek long straight solenoid ke andar, magnetic field sabhi points par same hota hai.
strings.b-18.paragraphs.1: Ek current-carrying solenoid coil ka use uske andar rakhi steel rod ko magnetise karne ke liye hota hai. Yeh arrangement ek electromagnet hota hai. Electromagnet mein soft iron ka core hota hai jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai.
strings.b-19.question: Sahi option chuniye. Current carry karte hue ek lambe straight solenoid ke andar magnetic field
strings.b-19.options.1: jaise-jaise hum iske end ki taraf badhte hain, yeh decrease hota hai.
strings.b-19.options.2: jaise-jaise hum iske end ki taraf badhte hain, yeh increase hota hai.
strings.b-19.explanation: Current carry karte hue ek lambe straight solenoid ke andar field lines parallel hoti hain aur field uniform hota hai, isliye iske andar sab points par field same hota hai.
strings.b-20.question: Bataiye ki nimnlikhit statement true hai ya false: Ek lambi circular coil jisme current flow ho raha hai, uske centre par field parallel straight lines hogi.
strings.b-20.explanation: Current-carrying circular coil ke centre par bade circles ke arcs straight lines jaise dikhte hain, aur wire ka har section wahan same direction me contribute karta hai, isliye centre par field lines parallel straight lines hoti hain.
strings.b-21.question: Ek circular loop of wire table ke plane mein rakha hai aur usme current clockwise flow ho raha hai, jaise upar se dekha gaya ho. Right-hand rule apply karte hue, loop ke centre par magnetic field kis direction mein hoga?
strings.b-21.options.0: table ke andar, table ke plane ke perpendicular.
strings.b-21.options.1: table ke bahar, table ke plane ke perpendicular.
strings.b-21.options.2: table ke along, north ki taraf.
strings.b-21.options.3: wire ke along hi, loop ke round.
strings.b-21.explanation: Apne right hand ki fingers ko current ki direction mein curl karein, yaani clockwise; phir aapka thumb table ke andar point karega. Loop ke andar wire ka har section apna field usi same direction mein contribute karta hai.
strings.b-22.paragraphs.0: Ek current-carrying conductor magnetic field paida karta hai, aur ye field conductor ke paas rakhe magnet par force (bal) lagata hai. French scientist Andre Marie Ampere ne suggest kiya ki magnet bhi current-carrying conductor par barabar aur opposite force lagata hoga.
strings.b-22.paragraphs.1: Ek chhota aluminium rod AB lagbhag 5 cm ka lein aur use stand se do connecting wires ki madad se horizontally latka dein. Ek strong horse-shoe magnet aise rakhein ki rod uske do poles ke beech mein ho aur magnetic field upwards directed ho: north pole vertically rod ke neeche aur south pole vertically rod ke upar. Rod ko battery, key aur rheostat ke saath series mein connect karein, aur rod mein current end B se end A ki taraf pass karein. Rod left ki taraf displace hota hai. Current ki direction reverse karein to rod right ki taraf displace hota hai.
strings.b-22.paragraphs.2: Ab magnet ke do poles interchange karke field ki direction vertically downwards kar dein. Current-carrying rod par lagne wale force ki direction phir se reverse ho jati hai. Isliye force ki direction current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction par depend karti hai.
strings.b-23.caption: Rod AB ko chhota circle bana kar dikhaya gaya hai kyunki ye page se seedha bahar aapki taraf aata hai; iske andar ka dot page se bahar aane wale current ko darshata hai. Magnetic field B upar ki taraf hai (north pole neeche, south pole upar), isliye rod par lagne wala force (bal) F dono ke perpendicular hai aur left ki taraf hai. Arrows sirf directions dikhate hain.
strings.b-24.paragraphs.0: Rod ka displacement (visthapan) sabse zyada hota hai, yani force (bal) ka magnitude sabse high hota hai, jab current ki direction Magnetic field ki direction ke right angles par hoti hai. Aisi condition mein ek simple rule force ki direction deta hai.
strings.b-24.paragraphs.1: Fleming's left-hand rule: apne left hand ke thumb, forefinger aur middle finger ko aise stretch karo ki wo mutually perpendicular hon. Agar first finger Magnetic field ki direction mein point karta hai aur second finger current ki direction mein, to thumb motion (gati) ki direction ya conductor par lagne wale force ki direction mein point karta hai.
strings.b-24.paragraphs.2: Yaad rakho ki current ki direction electrons ki motion (gati) ki direction ke opposite li jati hai. Jin devices mein current-carrying conductors aur Magnetic fields use hote hain unme electric motor, electric generator, loudspeakers, microphones aur measuring instruments shamil hain.
strings.b-25.problem: Ek electron horizontally east ki taraf move karta hai aur ek Magnetic field mein enter karta hai jo vertically upwards point karta hai, uski motion (gati) ke right angles par. Electron par act karne wala force (bal) kis direction mein point karta hai?
strings.b-25.steps.0.title: Field ki direction fix karein
strings.b-25.steps.0.detail: Magnetic field vertically upwards point karta hai, isliye left hand ki forefinger upar ki taraf point karti hai.
strings.b-25.steps.1.title: Current ki direction dhoondein
strings.b-25.steps.1.detail: Electron east ki taraf move karta hai. Current ki direction electrons ki motion ki direction ke opposite li jaati hai, isliye current west ki taraf hai. Second finger west ki taraf point karti hai.
strings.b-25.steps.2.title: Thumb se direction padhein
strings.b-25.steps.2.detail: Forefinger upar aur second finger west ki taraf point karti hui ho, to left hand ka thumb north ki taraf point karta hai.
strings.b-25.steps.3.title: Result bataayein
strings.b-25.steps.3.detail: Force field aur current dono ke perpendicular act karta hai, isliye ye horizontally north ki taraf directed hai.
strings.b-25.answer: Electron par lagne wala force north ki taraf act karta hai.
strings.b-26.question: Ek positively charged alpha-particle west ki taraf project kiya gaya hai aur magnetic field ke karan north ki taraf deflect ho jata hai. Magnetic field ki direction hai:
strings.b-26.explanation: Alpha-particle positively charged hai, isliye current west ki taraf hai. Fleming's left-hand rule ka use karte hue, thumb north (force (bal)) ki taraf point karega aur second finger west (current) ki taraf; forefinger phir upward point karega, jo field ki direction hai.
strings.b-27.question: Ek electron horizontally east ki taraf move karta hai. Electric current kis direction mein liya jata hai?
strings.b-27.explanation: Current ki direction electrons ke motion (gati) ki direction ke opposite li jati hai. Kyunki electron east ki taraf move karta hai, current west ki taraf liya jata hai.
strings.b-28.question: Aap ek chamber mein baithhe hain aur aapki peeth ek deewar ki taraf hai. Ek electron beam jo back wall se front wall ki taraf horizontally move kar raha hai, ek strong magnetic field ke karan aapke right side ki taraf deflect ho jata hai. Magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
strings.b-28.explanation: Electrons front wall ki taraf move karte hain, isliye current ko opposite direction mein liya jata hai, yaani back wall ki taraf. Force aapke right side ki taraf hai. Fleming's left-hand rule ke saath, thumb right ki taraf point karta hai aur second finger back wall ki taraf point karta hai; phir forefinger vertically neeche ki taraf point karta hai.
strings.b-29.question: Jab current-carrying conductor ko magnetic field mein rakha jata hai, to us par lagne wala force (bal) kab sabse zyada hota hai?
strings.b-29.options.0: Jab current magnetic field ke parallel hota hai.
strings.b-29.options.1: Jab current magnetic field ke right angles par hota hai.
strings.b-29.options.2: Jab conductor mein current zero hota hai.
strings.b-29.options.3: Jab conductor ko magnetic field ke bahar rakha jata hai.
strings.b-29.explanation: Activity mein rod ka displacement (visthapan), aur isliye force ka magnitude, sabse zyada tab hota hai jab current ki direction magnetic field ki direction ke right angles par hoti hai.
strings.b-30.question: Activity 12.7 mein, current-carrying rod par lagne wala force (bal) inmein se kis par depend karta hai?
strings.b-30.options.1: Sirf magnetic field ki direction par.
strings.b-30.options.2: Current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction dono par.
strings.b-30.options.3: Kisi par nahi; force ki direction fixed hoti hai.
strings.b-30.explanation: Current reverse karne se displacement (visthapan) ki direction reverse ho jati hai, aur poles interchange karke magnetic field ki direction badalne se bhi force reverse ho jata hai. Isliye force ki direction current ki direction aur field ki direction dono par depend karti hai.
strings.b-31.paragraphs.0: Electric power ghar tak main supply ke through pahunchti hai, chahe woh overhead electric poles se support ho ya underground cables se. Is supply ka ek wire, aam taur par red insulation ke saath, live wire (ya positive) kahlata hai. Dusra wire, black insulation ke saath, neutral wire (ya negative) kahlata hai. Hamare desh mein dono ke beech ka potential difference 220 V hai.
strings.b-31.paragraphs.1: Ghar ke meter-board par yeh wires main fuse ke through electricity meter mein jaate hain, aur main switch ke through ghar ki line wires se connect hote hain. Aksar do alag circuits use hote hain: ek 15 A current rating wala higher power rating wale appliances jaise geysers aur air coolers ke liye, aur dusra 5 A current rating wala bulbs aur fans ke liye.
strings.b-31.paragraphs.2: Earth wire ka insulation green colour ka hota hai aur ise aam taur par ghar ke paas zameen mein gehri metal plate se connect kiya jata hai. Yeh ek safety measure hai, khaas kar un appliances ke liye jinke metallic body hote hain, jaise electric press, toaster, table fan ya refrigerator. Metallic body ko earth wire se connect kiya jata hai, jo current ke liye low-resistance conducting path pradan karta hai. Phir metallic body mein current ka koi bhi leakage uska potential zameen ke barabar rakhta hai, aur user ko severe electric shock nahi lag sakta.
strings.b-32.caption: Ek aam domestic circuit. Bulb ka circuit aur appliance dono live aur neutral wires ke across connected hain, isliye woh parallel mein hain aur har ek ko same potential difference milta hai; har ek ka apna switch hai. lesson.title: Electric Current ke Magnetic Effects
objectives: Is lesson ke baad aap magnet ke magnetic field ko describe kar sakte hain aur magnetic field lines ke properties list kar sakte hain.
Is lesson ke baad aap right-hand thumb rule use karke straight wire, circular loop aur solenoid mein current se produce hone wale magnetic field ki direction find kar sakte hain.
Is lesson ke baad aap Fleming's left-hand rule use karke magnetic field mein rakhe current-carrying conductor par lagne wale force ki direction find kar sakte hain.
Is lesson ke baad aap domestic circuit ke live, neutral aur earth wires explain kar sakte hain, aur kyun electric fuse circuit ko short-circuiting aur overloading se protect karta hai.

sections.title: Current-carrying wire magnet ki tarah behave karta hai
paragraphs: Aap electric current ka ek effect pehle se jaante hain: jo wire se current flow hota hai, use garam karta hai. Ek second effect bhi hai. Current-carrying wire bhi magnet ki tarah behave karta hai, aur aap ise compass se dekh sakte hain.

Ek thick straight copper wire lo aur use electric circuit ke do points X aur Y ke beech connect karo. Wire ko paper ke plane ke perpendicular rakho. Wire ke paas ek small compass horizontally rakho aur uski needle ki position note karo.

Ab key insert karo taaki current flow ho, aur needle ko phir dekho. Needle deflect ho jaati hai. Copper wire se electric current ne magnetic effect produce kiya hai. Electricity aur magnetism ek dusre se linked hain.

Ye link accident se mila tha. 1820 mein Hans Christian Oersted ne discover kiya ki jab nearby rakhe metallic wire se electric current pass hota hai to compass needle deflect hoti hai. Unki observation ne dikhaya ki electricity aur magnetism related phenomena hain.

Is lesson mein aap seekhenge ki current magnetic field kaise produce karta hai, us field ki direction kaise find karte hain, magnet current-carrying conductor par force kaise lagata hai, aur ghar ki electric wiring kaise arrange hoti hai.

sections.title: Magnetic field aur field lines
paragraphs: Compass needle ek small bar magnet hoti hai. Iske do ends lagbhag north aur south directions ki taraf point karte hain. Jo end north ki taraf point karta hai use north-seeking ya north pole kehte hain; dusra end jo south ki taraf point karta hai use south-seeking ya south pole kehte hain. Like poles ek dusre ko repel karte hain, aur unlike poles ek dusre ko attract karte hain.

Drawing board par white paper ki sheet fix karo. Centre mein bar magnet rakho aur uske around iron filings uniformly sprinkle karo; salt-sprinkler use kar sakte hain. Board ko gently tap karo. Iron filings ek pattern mein arrange ho jaate hain.

Ye pattern mein kyun arrange hote hain? Magnet apne around ke region mein influence exert karta hai, aur filings force experience karte hain. Magnet ke surrounding region jahan magnet ka force detect kiya ja sakta hai, wahan magnetic field hota hai. Jis lines ke along iron filings align hote hain, woh magnetic field lines represent karti hain.

Aap ye lines khud small compass se draw kar sakte hain. Drawing board par fixed paper sheet par magnet rakho aur magnet ka boundary mark karo. Compass ko magnet ke north pole ke paas rakho: needle ka south pole magnet ke north pole ki taraf point karta hai, aur compass ka north pole magnet ke north pole se away directed hota hai. Needle ke dono ends ki positions mark karo.

Ab compass ko nayi position par move karo aisa ki uska south pole pehle wali north pole ki position occupy kare. Step by step aage badho jab tak magnet ke south pole tak na pahunch jao. Marked points ko smooth curve se join karo. Woh curve ek field line hai. Procedure repeat karo aur jitni lines draw kar sakte ho, draw karo.

Char properties samajh aati hain. Pehla, kisi point par magnetic field ki direction woh direction hoti hai jisme compass needle ka north pole wahan move karta. Convention ke hisaab se, field lines north pole se emerge hoti hain aur south pole par merge hoti hain, aur magnet ke andar unki direction south pole se north pole ki taraf hoti hai, isliye field lines closed curves hoti hain.

Dusra, field ki relative strength lines ki closeness se dikhti hai: jahan lines crowded hoti hain wahan field stronger hota hai. Teesra, koi bhi do field lines ek dusre ko cross nahi karti, kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions mein point karegi, jo possible nahi hai. Chautha, needle ka deflection badhta hai jab use field line ke along poles ki taraf move kiya jaata hai.

sections.title: Straight conductor se current ke karan magnetic field
paragraphs: Conductor se current ke karan generate hone wale magnetic field ka pattern kya decide karta hai? Pattern conductor ke shape par depend karta hai. Ek long straight wire se shuru karo.

Ek long straight copper wire, 1.5 V ke do ya teen cells aur ek plug key lo, aur unhe series mein connect karo. Straight wire ko compass needle ke parallel aur uske upar rakho, phir key plug karo. Agar current north se south flow hota hai, to compass needle ka north pole east ki taraf move karta hai. Ab cell connections badlo taaki current south se north flow ho; needle west ki taraf move karti hai. Current reverse hone par magnetic field ki direction reverse ho jaati hai.

Field ka shape dekhne ke liye ek long thick straight copper wire ko rectangular cardboard ke centre se, uske plane ke normal, pass karo, aur use 12 V battery, variable resistance (rheostat), ammeter aur plug key ke saath series mein connect karo. Cardboard par iron filings sprinkle karo, key close karo, aur cardboard ko gently tap karo. Filings copper wire ke around concentric circles ke pattern mein arrange ho jaate hain, aur ye circles magnetic field lines represent karte hain.
Compass ko kisi ek circle par kisi point par rakho. Jis direction mein needle ka north pole point karta hai, wahi us point par field line ki direction hoti hai.

Usi activity se do aur facts milte hain. Agar wire mein current increase karte ho, to needle ka deflection badh jaata hai; isliye kisi given point par magnetic field ka magnitude badhta hai jab wire se current badhta hai. Agar current same rakho lekin compass ko wire se door le jao, to deflection kam ho jaata hai; isliye given current se produce hone wala field kam hota hai jab wire se distance badhta hai. Wire se door jaane par concentric circles aur bade hote jaate hain.

sections.title: Right-hand thumb rule
paragraphs: Straight current-carrying conductor ke around field ki direction yaad rakhne ka ek convenient tarika yahan hai. Socho ki aap conductor ko apne right hand mein pakde hue ho aisa ki aapka thumb current ki direction ki taraf point kare. Phir aapki fingers conductor ke around field lines ki direction mein wrap hoti hain. Yahi right-hand thumb rule hai.

Isi rule ko Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kehte hain: agar aap socho ki aap corkscrew ko current ki direction mein drive kar rahe ho, to corkscrew ke rotation ki direction magnetic field ki direction hoti hai.

Yahan real line par use hota rule hai. Horizontal power line se current east se west direction mein flow hota hai. Wire ko apne right thumb ko east se west point karte hue pakdo aur fingers ko uske around curl hone do. Wire ke directly neeche ya directly upar kisi bhi point par, east end se dekhne par field wire ke perpendicular plane mein clockwise ghoomta hai, aur west end se dekhne par anti-clockwise.

sections.title: Circular loop se current ke karan magnetic field
paragraphs: Ab us straight wire ko circular loop mein bend karo aur usme current pass karo. Straight wire ka magnetic field usse distance ke inversely depend karta hai; usi tarah, current-carrying circular loop ke har point par field represent karne wale concentric circles wire se door jaane par bade hote jaate hain.

Jab hum loop ke centre tak pahunchte hain, in bade circles ke arcs straight lines ki tarah dikhte hain. Current-carrying wire ka har point aisa magnetic field produce karta hai jo loop ke centre par straight line ki tarah appear hota hai. Right-hand rule apply karne se pata chalta hai ki wire ka har section loop ke andar same direction mein magnetic field lines mein contribute karta hai.

Current-carrying wire kisi given point par jo magnetic field produce karta hai, woh usme pass hone wale current par directly depend karta hai. Isliye agar circular coil mein n turns hain, to produce hone wala field single turn ke field se n times bada hota hai: har circular turn mein current ki direction same hoti hai, aur turns ke fields simply add ho jaate hain.

Solenoid ek coil hoti hai jisme cylinder ke shape mein many circular turns wound hote hain. Current-carrying solenoid ke through aur around magnetic field lines ka pattern bar magnet jaisa hota hai, aur solenoid ka ek end magnetic north pole ki tarah act karta hai. Current-carrying long straight solenoid ke andar, har point par magnetic field same hota hai.

Current-carrying solenoid coil ka use uske andar rakhi steel rod ko magnetise karne ke liye kiya jaata hai. Ye arrangement electromagnet hai. Electromagnet mein soft iron ka core hota hai jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai.

sections.title: Magnetic field mein current-carrying conductor par force
paragraphs: Current-carrying conductor magnetic field produce karta hai, aur woh field conductor ke paas rakhe magnet par force lagata hai. French scientist Andre Marie Ampere ne suggest kiya ki magnet bhi current-carrying conductor par equal aur opposite force lagata hoga.

Lagbhag 5 cm ki small aluminium rod AB lo aur use do connecting wires se stand se horizontally suspend karo. Ek strong horse-shoe magnet aise rakho ki rod uske do poles ke beech ho aur magnetic field upwards directed ho: north pole vertically neeche aur south pole vertically rod ke upar. Rod ko battery, key aur rheostat ke saath series mein connect karo, aur rod mein current end B se end A ki taraf pass karo. Rod left ki taraf displaced hoti hai. Current ki direction reverse karo aur rod right ki taraf displaced hoti hai.

Ab magnet ke do poles interchange karke field ki direction vertically downwards kar do. Current-carrying rod par lagne wale force ki direction phir reverse ho jaati hai. Isliye force ki direction current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction par depend karti hai.

Rod ka displacement sabse zyada hota hai, yani force ka magnitude highest hota hai, jab current ki direction magnetic field ki direction ke right angles par hoti hai. Aisi condition mein ek simple rule force ki direction deta hai.

Fleming's left-hand rule: apne left hand ke thumb, forefinger aur middle finger ko aise stretch karo ki woh mutually perpendicular hon. Agar first finger magnetic field ki direction mein point kare aur second finger current ki direction mein, to thumb motion ki direction ya conductor par lagne wale force ki direction mein point karta hai.

Yaad rakho ki current ki direction electrons ke motion ki direction ke opposite li jaati hai. Current-carrying conductors aur magnetic fields use karne wale devices mein electric motor, electric generator, loudspeakers, microphones aur measuring instruments shamil hain.

sections.title: Domestic electric circuits
paragraphs: Electric power ghar tak main supply se pahunchti hai, chahe woh overhead electric poles se support ho ya underground cables se. Is supply ka ek wire, usually red insulation wala, live wire (ya positive) kehlata hai. Dusra wire, black insulation wala, neutral wire (ya negative) kehlata hai. Hamare desh mein dono ke beech potential difference 220 V hota hai.

Ghar ke meter-board par ye wires main fuse ke through electricity meter mein jaate hain, aur main switch ke through ghar ki line wires se connect hote hain. Aksar do separate circuits use hote hain: ek 15 A current rating wala higher power rating wale appliances jaise geysers aur air coolers ke liye, aur dusra 5 A current rating wala bulbs aur fans ke liye.

Earth wire ki insulation green colour ki hoti hai aur usually ghar ke paas earth mein deep metal plate se connected hoti hai. Ye safety measure hai, khaas taur par un appliances ke liye jinka metallic body hota hai, jaise electric press, toaster, table fan ya refrigerator. Metallic body earth wire se connect hoti hai, jo current ke liye low-resistance conducting path provide karta hai. Phir metallic body mein koi bhi current leakage uska potential earth ke potential ke equal rakhta hai, aur user ko severe electric shock nahi lag sakta.

Har separate circuit mein, different appliances live aur neutral wires ke across connect kiye ja sakte hain, aur har appliance ka current on/off karne ke liye separate switch hota hai. Taaki har appliance ko equal potential difference mile, appliances ek dusre ke parallel connect kiye jaate hain.

Fuse sabhi domestic circuits ka important component hai. Ye overloading ke karan appliances aur circuit ko damage hone se bachata hai. Overloading tab ho sakti hai jab live wire aur neutral wire direct contact mein aa jayein; ye tab hota hai jab wires ki insulation damaged ho ya appliance mein fault ho. Aisi situation mein circuit ka current abruptly badh jaata hai, aur ise short-circuiting kehte hain. Fuse mein hone wali Joule heating use melt kar deti hai taaki electric circuit break ho aur unduly high current ka flow ruk jaye.
Overloading supply voltage mein accidental hike ke karan bhi ho sakti hai, aur kabhi kabhi ek hi socket se bahut saare appliances connect karne se bhi hoti hai.

sections.title: Medicine mein magnetism
paragraphs: Electric current hamesha magnetic field produce karta hai. Hamare body ki nerve cells ke along travel karne wale weak ion currents bhi magnetic fields produce karte hain. Jab aap kisi cheez ko touch karte ho, aapki nerves electric impulse ko un muscles tak le jaati hain jinhe use karna hota hai, aur ye impulse temporary magnetic field produce karta hai. Aise fields bahut weak hote hain, lagbhag earth ke magnetic field ka one-billionth.

Human body mein do main organs jahan produce hone wala magnetic field significant hota hai, woh heart aur brain hain. Body ke andar ka magnetic field Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) naam ki technique se different body parts ki images obtain karne ka basis banata hai, aur in images ka analysis medical diagnosis mein help karta hai.

paragraphs: Ab chaar properties follow hoti hain. Pehli, kisi point par magnetic field ki direction wahi hoti hai jis direction mein compass needle ka north pole wahan move karta. Convention ke hisaab se, field lines north pole se bahar nikalti hain aur south pole par milti hain, aur magnet ke andar unki direction south pole se north pole ki taraf hoti hai, isliye field lines closed curves hoti hain.

Doosri, field ki relative strength lines ke closeness ki degree se dikhti hai: jahan lines crowded hoti hain wahan field stronger hota hai. Teesri, koi bhi do field lines ek doosre ko cross nahi karti, kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions ki taraf point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
Chauthi, needle ka deflection badhta hai jab use field line ke along poles ki taraf move kiya jata hai.

spec.title: Compass se ek magnetic field line kaise draw karein

steps.title: Setup karein
steps.detail: Drawing board par white paper ki ek sheet fix karein, us par bar magnet rakhein aur magnet ki boundary mark karein.

steps.title: Pehli position
steps.detail: Compass ko magnet ke north pole ke paas rakhein. Needle ka south pole magnet ke north pole ki taraf point karta hai, aur compass ka north pole magnet ke north pole se door ki direction mein hota hai. Needle ke dono ends ki positions mark karein.

steps.title: Aage badhein
steps.detail: Needle ko nayi position par move karein aise ki uska south pole wahi position le le jo pehle uske north pole ne li thi.

steps.title: South pole tak continue karein
steps.detail: Isi tarah step by step aage badhein jab tak magnet ke south pole tak na pahunch jayein.

steps.title: Marks ko join karein
steps.detail: Paper par mark kiye gaye points ko ek smooth curve se join karein. Yeh curve ek field line represent karti hai.

steps.title: Repeat karein
steps.detail: Poora procedure repeat karein aur jitni lines draw kar sakte hain utni lines draw karein. Saath milkar yeh magnet ke around magnetic field represent karti hain.

spec.question: Do magnetic field lines ek dusre ko intersect kyun nahi karti?
options: Kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions ki taraf point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
Kyunki field lines hamesha straight hoti hain aur straight lines kabhi meet nahi karti.
Kyunki har crossing point par magnetic field zero hota hai.
Kyunki field lines sirf magnet ke andar exist karti hain.
spec.answer: Kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions ki taraf point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
spec.explanation: Kisi point par field ki direction wahi hoti hai jis direction mein compass needle ka north pole wahan move karega. Ek single point do directions nahi de sakta, isliye do field lines cross nahi kar sakti.
spec.expected_understanding: Student field direction ki definition use karke explain karta hai ki field lines kabhi cross kyun nahi karti.

spec.question: Is chapter mein magnetic field produce karne ke kaun se do methods dikhaye gaye hain?
options: Magnet ka use karke, aur conductor se electric current pass karke.
Wire ko garam karke, aur magnet ko thanda karke.
Copper wire ko ragad karke, aur magnet ko tukdon mein todkar.
Wire par light daal kar, aur tez awaaz karke.
spec.answer: Magnet ka use karke, aur conductor se electric current pass karke.
spec.explanation: Magnetic field magnet ke aas-paas ke region mein hota hai, aur electric current carry karne wale metallic wire ke saath bhi ek magnetic field associated hota hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student yaad karta hai ki magnet aur current-carrying conductors dono magnetic fields ke sources hain.

paragraphs: Current ke through conductor mein generate hone wale magnetic field ka pattern kya decide karta hai? Pattern conductor ki shape par depend karta hai. Long straight wire se start karte hain.

Ek long straight copper wire, 1.5 V ke do ya teen cells aur ek plug key lein, aur unhe series mein connect karein. Straight wire ko compass needle ke parallel aur uske upar rakhein, phir key plug karein. Agar current north se south ki taraf flow karta hai, to compass needle ka north pole east ki taraf move karta hai. Ab cell connections ko replace karein taki current south se north ki taraf flow kare; needle west ki taraf move karta hai. Current reverse hone par magnetic field ki direction reverse ho jati hai.

paragraphs: Same experiment se do aur facts milte hain. Agar aap wire mein current badhate hain, to needle ka deflection badh jata hai; iska matlab hai ki kisi diye gaye point par magnetic field ka magnitude badh jata hai jab wire mein current badhta hai.

Agar aap current same rakhte hain lekin compass ko wire se door le jaate hain, to deflection kam ho jata hai; iska matlab hai ki diye gaye current se produce hone wala field kam ho jata hai jab wire se distance (doori) badhta hai. Field ko represent karne wale concentric circles aur bade hote jaate hain jab hum wire se door jaate hain.

spec.question: Nimnlikhit mein se kaun sa sahi tarah se ek lambi seedhi current-carrying wire ke paas magnetic field (chumbakiya kshetra) ka varnan karta hai?
options: Field seedhi lines se bana hai jo wire ke perpendicular hain.
Field seedhi lines se bana hai jo wire ke parallel hain.
Field radial lines se bana hai jo wire se nikalti hain.
Field concentric circles se bana hai jo wire par kendrit hain.
spec.answer: Field concentric circles se bana hai jo wire par kendrit hain.
spec.explanation: Ek seedhi current-carrying wire ke aas-paas chhidke hue iron filings wire ke chaaron taraf concentric circles mein vyavasthit ho jate hain, aur yeh circles field lines ko darshate hain.
spec.expected_understanding: Vidyarthi ek seedhi current-carrying conductor ke field ke circular pattern ko pehchanta hai.

paragraphs: Yahan ek aasan tarika hai yaad rakhne ka ki ek seedhi current-carrying conductor ke around field ki direction kya hoti hai. Socho ki aap conductor ko apne right hand mein is tarah pakde hue hain ki aapka thumb current ki direction ki taraf point karta hai. Phir aapki fingers conductor ke around field lines ki direction mein lapet jaati hain. Yahi right-hand thumb rule hai.

Isi rule ko Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kaha jata hai: agar aap maan lein ki aap current ki direction mein ek corkscrew drive kar rahe hain, to corkscrew ke rotation ki direction hi magnetic field (chumbakiya kshetra) ki direction hoti hai.

spec.problem: Ek horizontal power line mein current east se west direction mein flow karta hai. Iske exactly neeche ek point aur exactly upar ek point par magnetic field ki direction kya hai?

steps.title: Thumb ko point karo
steps.detail: Power line ko apne right hand mein is tarah pakdo ki aapka thumb current ke along point kare, yani east se west.

steps.title: Fingers ko curl karo
steps.detail: Aapki fingers wire ke around wrap ho jati hain. Ye wire ke perpendicular plane mein field lines ki direction batati hain.

steps.title: Ek end se dekho
steps.detail: East end se dekhein to ye curling clockwise hai; west end se dekhein to anti-clockwise.

steps.title: Upar aur neeche same
steps.detail: Wire ke exactly neeche ya exactly upar kisi point par kuch nahi badalta: east end se dekhein to field abhi bhi wire ke perpendicular plane mein clockwise turn karta hai, aur west end se dekhein to anti-clockwise.

spec.answer: Wire ke exactly neeche ya exactly upar kisi bhi point par, east end se dekhein to magnetic field wire ke perpendicular plane mein clockwise turn karta hai, aur west end se dekhein to anti-clockwise.

spec.question: Kaun sa rule straight current-carrying conductor ke around produce hone wale magnetic field ki direction batata hai?
options: Right-hand thumb rule, jise Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kaha jata hai.
Woh rule jis ke anusar compass needle north ki taraf point karti hai.
Woh rule jis ke anusar like poles repel karte hain aur unlike poles attract karte hain.
Woh rule jis ke anusar iron filings straight lines mein settle hoti hain.
spec.answer: Right-hand thumb rule, jise Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kaha jata hai.
spec.explanation: Current-carrying straight conductor ko apne right hand mein is tarah pakdo ki thumb current ki direction mein point kare. Phir aapki fingers conductor ke around magnetic field lines ki direction mein wrap hoti hain.
spec.expected_understanding: Student right-hand thumb rule ko straight current-carrying conductor ke around magnetic field ki direction ke rule ke roop mein identify karta hai.

paragraphs: Ab us straight wire ko circular loop mein bend karo aur usme current pass karo. Ek straight wire ka magnetic field usse distance (doori) par inversely depend karta hai; isi tarah, current-carrying circular loop ke har point par field ko represent karne wale concentric circles wire se door jane par aur bade hote jaate hain.

Jab hum loop ke centre tak pahunchte hain, in bade circles ke arcs straight lines jaise dikhte hain. Current-carrying wire ka har point aisa magnetic field banata hai jo loop ke centre par straight line jaise dikhta hai. Right-hand rule apply karne se pata chalta hai ki wire ka har section loop ke andar magnetic field lines ko same direction mein contribute karta hai.

Kisi given point par current-carrying wire se produce hone wala magnetic field usme pass hone wale current par directly depend karta hai. Isliye agar ek circular coil mein n turns hain, to produce hone wala field single turn se produce hone wale field ka n times hota hai: har circular turn mein current ki direction same hoti hai, aur turns ke due to fields simply add up ho jaate hain.

paragraphs: Solenoid ek coil hoti hai jisme cylinder ke shape mein wound kai circular turns hote hain. Current-carrying solenoid ke through aur uske around magnetic field lines ka pattern bar magnet jaisa hota hai, aur solenoid ka ek end magnetic north pole ki tarah act karta hai. Current carry karte hue ek long straight solenoid ke andar, magnetic field sabhi points par same hota hai.

Ek current-carrying solenoid coil ka use uske andar rakhi steel rod ko magnetise karne ke liye hota hai. Yeh arrangement ek electromagnet hota hai. Electromagnet mein soft iron ka core hota hai jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai.

spec.question: Sahi option chuniye. Current carry karte hue ek lambe straight solenoid ke andar magnetic field
options: zero hai.
jaise-jaise hum iske end ki taraf badhte hain, yeh decrease hota hai.
jaise-jaise hum iske end ki taraf badhte hain, yeh increase hota hai.
sab points par same hai.
spec.answer: sab points par same hai.
spec.explanation: Current carry karte hue ek lambe straight solenoid ke andar field lines parallel hoti hain aur field uniform hota hai, isliye iske andar sab points par field same hota hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student ko pata hai ki ek lambe current-carrying solenoid ke andar field uniform hota hai.

spec.question: Bataiye ki nimnlikhit statement true hai ya false: Ek lambi circular coil jisme current flow ho raha hai, uske centre par field parallel straight lines hogi.
options: True
False
spec.answer: True
spec.explanation: Current-carrying circular coil ke centre par bade circles ke arcs straight lines jaise dikhte hain, aur wire ka har section wahan same direction me contribute karta hai, isliye centre par field lines parallel straight lines hoti hain.
spec.expected_understanding: Student ko yaad hai ki current-carrying coil ke centre par field kaisa dikhta hai.

spec.question: Ek circular loop of wire table ke plane mein rakha hai aur usme current clockwise flow ho raha hai, jaise upar se dekha gaya ho. Right-hand rule apply karte hue, loop ke centre par magnetic field kis direction mein hoga?
options: table ke andar, table ke plane ke perpendicular.
table ke bahar, table ke plane ke perpendicular.
table ke along, north ki taraf.
wire ke along hi, loop ke round.
spec.answer: table ke andar, table ke plane ke perpendicular.
spec.explanation: Apne right hand ki fingers ko current ki direction mein curl karein, yaani clockwise; phir aapka thumb table ke andar point karega. Loop ke andar wire ka har section apna field usi same direction mein contribute karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student circular loop par right-hand rule apply karke uske centre par field ki direction find karta hai.

paragraphs: Ek current-carrying conductor magnetic field paida karta hai, aur ye field conductor ke paas rakhe magnet par force (bal) lagata hai. French scientist Andre Marie Ampere ne suggest kiya ki magnet bhi current-carrying conductor par barabar aur opposite force lagata hoga.

Ek chhota aluminium rod AB lagbhag 5 cm ka lein aur use stand se do connecting wires ki madad se horizontally latka dein. Ek strong horse-shoe magnet aise rakhein ki rod uske do poles ke beech mein ho aur magnetic field upwards directed ho: north pole vertically rod ke neeche aur south pole vertically rod ke upar. Rod ko battery, key aur rheostat ke saath series mein connect karein, aur rod mein current end B se end A ki taraf pass karein. Rod left ki taraf displace hota hai. Current ki direction reverse karein to rod right ki taraf displace hota hai.

Ab magnet ke do poles interchange karke field ki direction vertically downwards kar dein. Current-carrying rod par lagne wale force ki direction phir se reverse ho jati hai. Isliye force ki direction current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction par depend karti hai.

Magnetic field B upar ki taraf hai (north pole neeche, south pole upar), isliye rod par lagne wala force (bal) F dono ke perpendicular hai aur left ki taraf hai. Arrows sirf directions dikhate hain.

paragraphs: Rod ka displacement (visthapan) sabse zyada hota hai, yani force (bal) ka magnitude sabse high hota hai, jab current ki direction Magnetic field ki direction ke right angles par hoti hai. Aisi condition mein ek simple rule force ki direction deta hai.

Fleming's left-hand rule: apne left hand ke thumb, forefinger aur middle finger ko aise stretch karo ki wo mutually perpendicular hon. Agar first finger Magnetic field ki direction mein point karta hai aur second finger current ki direction mein, to thumb motion (gati) ki direction ya conductor par lagne wale force ki direction mein point karta hai.

Yaad rakho ki current ki direction electrons ki motion (gati) ki direction ke opposite li jati hai. Jin devices mein current-carrying conductors aur Magnetic fields use hote hain unme electric motor, electric generator, loudspeakers, microphones aur measuring instruments shamil hain.

spec.problem: Ek electron horizontally east ki taraf move karta hai aur ek Magnetic field mein enter karta hai jo vertically upwards point karta hai, uski motion (gati) ke right angles par. Electron par act karne wala force (bal) kis direction mein point karta hai?

steps.title: Field ki direction fix karein
steps.detail: Magnetic field vertically upwards point karta hai, isliye left hand ki forefinger upar ki taraf point karti hai.

steps.title: Current ki direction dhoondein
steps.detail: Electron east ki taraf move karta hai. Current ki direction electrons ki motion ki direction ke opposite li jaati hai, isliye current west ki taraf hai. Second finger west ki taraf point karti hai.

steps.title: Thumb se direction padhein
steps.detail: Forefinger upar aur second finger west ki taraf point karti hui ho, to left hand ka thumb north ki taraf point karta hai.

steps.title: Result bataayein
steps.detail: Force field aur current dono ke perpendicular act karta hai, isliye ye horizontally north ki taraf directed hai.

spec.answer: Electron par lagne wala force north ki taraf act karta hai.

spec.question: Ek positively charged alpha-particle west ki taraf project kiya gaya hai aur magnetic field ke karan north ki taraf deflect ho jata hai. Magnetic field ki direction hai:
options: south ki taraf
east ki taraf
neeche ki taraf
upar ki taraf
spec.answer: upar ki taraf
spec.explanation: Alpha-particle positively charged hai, isliye current west ki taraf hai. Fleming's left-hand rule ka use karte hue, thumb north (force (bal)) ki taraf point karega aur second finger west (current) ki taraf; forefinger phir upward point karega, jo field ki direction hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student Fleming's left-hand rule ko moving positive charge par apply karta hai aur field ki direction identify karta hai.

spec.question: Ek electron horizontally east ki taraf move karta hai. Electric current kis direction mein liya jata hai?
options: West ki taraf
East ki taraf
Vertically upar ki taraf
Vertically neeche ki taraf
spec.answer: West ki taraf
spec.explanation: Current ki direction electrons ke motion (gati) ki direction ke opposite li jati hai. Kyunki electron east ki taraf move karta hai, current west ki taraf liya jata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student is convention ko recall karta hai ki current ki direction electron motion (gati) ki direction ke opposite hoti hai.

spec.question: Aap ek chamber mein baithhe hain aur aapki peeth ek deewar ki taraf hai. Ek electron beam jo back wall se front wall ki taraf horizontally move kar raha hai, ek strong magnetic field ke karan aapke right side ki taraf deflect ho jata hai. Magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
options: vertically neeche ki taraf
vertically upar ki taraf
front wall ki taraf
back wall ki taraf
spec.answer: vertically neeche ki taraf
spec.explanation: Electrons front wall ki taraf move karte hain, isliye current ko opposite direction mein liya jata hai, yaani back wall ki taraf. Force aapke right side ki taraf hai. Fleming's left-hand rule ke saath, thumb right ki taraf point karta hai aur second finger back wall ki taraf point karta hai; phir forefinger vertically neeche ki taraf point karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student electron motion ko reverse karke current direction nikalta hai aur phir three dimensions mein Fleming's left-hand rule apply karta hai.

spec.question: Jab current-carrying conductor ko magnetic field mein rakha jata hai, to us par lagne wala force (bal) kab sabse zyada hota hai?
options: Jab current magnetic field ke parallel hota hai.
Jab current magnetic field ke right angles par hota hai.
Jab conductor mein current zero hota hai.
Jab conductor ko magnetic field ke bahar rakha jata hai.
spec.answer: Jab current magnetic field ke right angles par hota hai.
spec.explanation: Activity mein rod ka displacement (visthapan), aur isliye force ka magnitude, sabse zyada tab hota hai jab current ki direction magnetic field ki direction ke right angles par hoti hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student current-carrying conductor par sabse zyada magnetic force ki condition batata hai.

spec.question: Activity 12.7 mein, current-carrying rod par lagne wala force (bal) inmein se kis par depend karta hai?
options: Sirf current ki direction par.
Sirf magnetic field ki direction par.
Current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction dono par.
Kisi par nahi; force ki direction fixed hoti hai.
spec.answer: Current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction dono par.
spec.explanation: Current reverse karne se displacement (visthapan) ki direction reverse ho jati hai, aur poles interchange karke magnetic field ki direction badalne se bhi force reverse ho jata hai. Isliye force ki direction current ki direction aur field ki direction dono par depend karti hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student yeh batata hai ki current-carrying conductor par lagne wale magnetic force ki direction current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction dono par depend karti hai.

paragraphs: Electric power ghar tak main supply ke through pahunchti hai, chahe woh overhead electric poles se support ho ya underground cables se. Is supply ka ek wire, aam taur par red insulation ke saath, live wire (ya positive) kahlata hai. Dusra wire, black insulation ke saath, neutral wire (ya negative) kahlata hai. Hamare desh mein dono ke beech ka potential difference 220 V hai.

Ghar ke meter-board par yeh wires main fuse ke through electricity meter mein jaate hain, aur main switch ke through ghar ki line wires se connect hote hain. Aksar do alag circuits use hote hain: ek 15 A current rating wala higher power rating wale appliances jaise geysers aur air coolers ke liye, aur dusra 5 A current rating wala bulbs aur fans ke liye.

Earth wire ka insulation green colour ka hota hai aur ise aam taur par ghar ke paas zameen mein gehri metal plate se connect kiya jata hai. Yeh ek safety measure hai, khaas kar un appliances ke liye jinke metallic body hote hain, jaise electric press, toaster, table fan ya refrigerator. Metallic body ko earth wire se connect kiya jata hai, jo current ke liye low-resistance conducting path pradan karta hai. Phir metallic body mein current ka koi bhi leakage uska potential zameen ke barabar rakhta hai, aur user ko severe electric shock nahi lag sakta.

spec.caption: Ek aam domestic circuit. Bulb ka circuit aur appliance dono live aur neutral wires ke across connected hain, isliye woh parallel mein hain aur har ek ko same potential difference milta hai; har ek ka apna switch hai. Appliance ke metal body ko earth wire se joda gaya hai. Jahan lines bina dot ke cross karti hain, wahan koi connection nahi hota.

paragraphs: Har alag circuit mein, different appliances ko live aur neutral wires ke across connect kiya ja sakta hai, aur har appliance ka apna separate switch hota hai jo current ko on aur off karta hai. Isliye ki har appliance ko equal potential difference mile, appliances ko ek dusre ke parallel connect kiya jata hai.

Fuse sabhi domestic circuits ka ek important component hai. Yeh overloading ke karan appliances aur circuit ko damage hone se rokta hai. Overloading tab ho sakta hai jab live wire aur neutral wire direct contact mein aa jayein; aisa tab hota hai jab wires ki insulation damaged ho ya appliance mein fault ho. Aisi situation mein circuit ka current abruptly badh jata hai, aur ise short-circuiting kehte hain. Fuse mein hone wali Joule heating use melt kar deti hai, jisse electric circuit toot jata hai aur unduly high current ka flow ruk jata hai.
Overloading supply voltage mein accidental hike ke karan bhi ho sakta hai, aur kabhi-kabhi ek hi socket se bahut zyada appliances connect karne se hota hai.

spec.problem: Ek domestic circuit mein, ek wire ki insulation damage ho jaati hai aur live wire seedha neutral wire ke contact mein aa jaati hai. Explain kijiye ki circuit mein kya hota hai aur fuse kya karta hai.

steps.title: Direct contact
steps.detail: Live wire aur neutral wire seedha contact mein aa jaate hain. Isse short-circuiting kehte hain.

steps.title: Current increases
steps.detail: Is direct contact ki wajah se circuit mein current achaanak badh jaata hai.

steps.title: Fuse heats
steps.detail: Bahut zyada high current fuse mein Joule heating paida karta hai.

steps.title: Circuit breaks
steps.detail: Joule heating se fuse melt ho jaata hai, jisse electric circuit toot jaata hai aur bahut zyada high current ka flow ruk jaata hai; isse appliances aur circuit ko damage hone se bachaaya jaata hai.

spec.answer: Damaged insulation short-circuiting ka kaaran banta hai: live aur neutral wires ek dusre ko touch karte hain, current achaanak badh jaata hai, aur Joule heating fuse ko melt kar deta hai, jisse circuit toot jaata hai aur damage se bachaav hota hai.

spec.question: Short circuit ke time, circuit mein current
options: kaafi kam ho jaata hai.
nahin badalta.
bahut zyada badh jaata hai.
lagataar badalta rehta hai.
spec.answer: bahut zyada badh jaata hai.
spec.explanation: Jab live wire aur neutral wire seedha contact mein aa jaate hain, to circuit mein current achanak badh jaata hai; ise short-circuiting kehte hain.
spec.expected_understanding: Student short circuit ke defining effect ko yaad karta hai.

spec.question: Electric short circuit kab hota hai?
options: Jab live wire aur neutral wire seedha contact mein aa jaate hain.
Jab earth wire ground mein metal plate se connect kiya jata hai.
Jab ek hi samay par bahut zyada appliances switch off kar diye jaate hain.
Jab supply voltage 220 V se neeche gir jata hai.
spec.answer: Jab live wire aur neutral wire seedha contact mein aa jaate hain.
spec.explanation: Yeh tab hota hai jab wires ki insulation damaged ho jati hai ya appliance mein fault hota hai, aur phir circuit mein current achanak badh jata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student short-circuiting ka cause identify karta hai.

spec.question: Earth wire ka function kya hai, aur metallic appliances ko earth karna kyon zaroori hai?
options: Yeh ek low-resistance conducting path provide karta hai, isliye metallic body mein current ka koi bhi leakage hone par uska potential earth ke potential par bana rehta hai aur user ko severe electric shock nahi lagta.
Yeh live wire ke bajaye working current ko appliance tak pahunchata hai.
Yeh circuit mein current badha deta hai taaki appliance tez chale.
Yeh appliance ke liye alternating supply ko direct current mein convert karta hai.
spec.answer: Yeh ek low-resistance conducting path provide karta hai, isliye metallic body mein current ka koi bhi leakage hone par uska potential earth ke potential par bana rehta hai aur user ko severe electric shock nahi lagta.
spec.explanation: Earth wire ko earth ke andar gehri metal plate se connect kiya jata hai. Jab appliance ki metallic body isse jod di jati hai, to leakage current user ke through jaane ke bajaye safely earth mein chala jata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student earthing ko metallic body wale appliances ke liye safety measure ke roop mein explain karta hai.

spec.question: Bataiye ki nimnlikhit kathan sahi hai ya galat: green insulation wala wire aam taur par electric supply ka live wire hota hai.
options: Sahi
Galat
spec.answer: Galat
spec.explanation: Green insulation wala wire Earth wire hota hai. Live wire par aam taur par red insulation hoti hai aur neutral wire par black insulation hoti hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student ko domestic supply ke teen wires ke colour code yaad hain.

spec.question: Electric circuits aur appliances mein aam taur par use hone wale do safety measures ke naam bataiye.
options: Electric fuse aur earth wire.
Switch aur bulb.
Rheostat aur ammeter.
Magnet aur compass.
spec.answer: Electric fuse aur earth wire.
spec.explanation: Jab current bahut zyada high hota hai to fuse pighal kar circuit tod deta hai, aur earth wire leakage current ko safely earth tak le jaata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student chapter mein bataye gaye do safety devices ke naam batata hai.

spec.question: Domestic electric circuits ke overloading se bachne ke liye kya precaution lena chahiye?
options: Ek hi socket par bahut zyada appliances mat lagaiye, aur circuit ki rating se zyada current mat draw kijiye.
Ghar ke sabhi appliances ko series mein connect kijiye.
Main board se fuse nikaal dijiye.
Metallic appliances se earth wire disconnect kar dijiye.
spec.answer: Ek hi socket par bahut zyada appliances mat lagaiye, aur circuit ki rating se zyada current mat draw kijiye.
spec.explanation: Overloading tab ho sakti hai jab ek hi socket par bahut zyada appliances connect kiye jaate hain, aur supply voltage mein accidental increase se bhi; agar aisa hota hai to circuit break karne ke liye fuse hota hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student rozmarra ki wiring aadaton ko overloading ke cause se jodta hai.

paragraphs: Electric current hamesha magnetic field produce karta hai. Hamare body ki nerve cells ke saath travel karne wale weak ion currents bhi magnetic field produce karte hain. Jab aap kisi cheez ko touch karte hain, to aapki nerves aapko use karne wale muscles tak electric impulse pahunchati hain, aur ye impulse ek temporary magnetic field produce karta hai. Aise fields bahut weak hote hain, lagbhag earth ke magnetic field ka one-billionth.

Human body ke andar jin do main organs mein produce hone wala magnetic field significant hota hai, wo heart aur brain hain. Body ke andar ka magnetic field Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) naam ki technique se different body parts ke images obtain karne ka basis banata hai, aur in images ka analysis medical diagnosis mein madad karta hai.

spec.question: Kaunsi technique human body ke andar ke magnetic field ka use karke different body parts ki images obtain karti hai?
options: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI).
Short-circuiting.
Earthing.
Right-hand thumb rule.
spec.answer: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI).
spec.explanation: Body ke andar ka magnetic field, jo heart aur brain mein significant hota hai, MRI dwara body parts ki images obtain karne ka basis hai, aur in images ka analysis medical diagnosis mein help karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Student chapter mein describe kiye gaye magnetism ke ek important medical use ko recall karta hai.
